subject: Action Require: Confirming the employment details

body:
Dear John,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Alexandra Martin, and I am reaching out on behalf of EquiFinance Credit Bureau. We are currently in the process of assessing a loan application from an employee at your firm. As part of our assessment to determine the creditworthiness of our applicants, we require verification of employment of Jane Smith and Jacob Johnson.

According to our records, you are the designated HR representative at NexTech Solutions, and therefore the appropriate contact for this request. 

We would be grateful if you could provide the requested information at your earliest convenience. If you have any concerns or require further clarification regarding this request, please do not hesitate to contact me directly.

Thank you very much for your time and cooperation. We appreciate your assistance in helping us complete this important process.

Warm regards,

Alexandra Martin
Loan Application Analyst
EquiFinance Credit Bureau
